Tamil Nadu CM Pushes for Tamil as Madras High Court Language

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is set to move a resolution urging the Union government to recognize Tamil as the principal language of the Madras High Court. This move follows a similar resolution passed in 2006. The Chief Minister's office has indicated that the resolution will be presented to the Centre. The push aims to elevate the status of Tamil within the judicial proceedings of the High Court.
